description: Na₄MgTi₂(GeO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.40 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.08 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.10 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to five O atoms to form TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.04 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.80 Å) and one longer (2.13 Å) Ge-O bond length. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (1.76 Å) and two longer (1.82 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₂MgTi trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂TiGe tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgTi trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgTiGe trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one Ge atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Ge atom to form ONa₂TiGe tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgTiGe trigonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgTi trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, one Ti, and one Ge atom to form distorted ONa₂MgTiGe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂TiGe tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONa₂MgTi trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Ti atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ti atom.
